description: Finite-sample quantiles of the union-of-rejections statistic U (Harvey, Leybourne and Taylor 2012) under the unit-root null, as a response surface in T (length of the series) and k (lagged differences, common to the four tests). Decision D22 of the specification.
model: q_p(T, k) = intercept[p] + slopes[k][p][1] / T + slopes[k][p][2] / T^2 + slopes[k][p][3] / T^3
statistic: U = min over i of stat_i / |cv_i(0.05; T, k)|, i = ADF with constant (tau, trend c), ADF with constant and trend (tau, ct), DF-GLS with constant (c), DF-GLS with constant and trend (ct); all with k lagged differences on the maximal sample t = k+2..T. cv_i are the 5% critical values of tau_response_surfaces.json (trends c, ct) and dfgls_response_surfaces.json (trends c, ct) at the same T and k; the reference rows give them (cv5_*).

usage.critical_value: evaluate the model at p = 0.01, 0.05, 0.10; reject the unit root when U is below it
usage.p_value: lower tail, as for tau: linear interpolation of qnorm(probs) against the quantiles; exactly the tabulated probability at a quantile; bounds 0.001/0.999 beyond them
usage.outside_design: use k = min(k, max(k)); use T = max(T, Tmin[k]) from design; never extrapolate; warn
usage.lags: one k for the four tests, selected (by default MAIC) on the ADF regression with constant and trend

source.simulation: driftless random walk, N(0,1); same (T, k) design as tau; 25 x 10,000 replications per T

reference_values.note: R unitroottools 0.3.4: critical values at 1/5/10% and p-value of `stat`; to 1e-12
